name: Boole’s algebra of logic
description: Boole represented classes and logical relationships algebraically, making logical reasoning an object of symbolic calculation.

impact.note: Used by logicians, mathematicians and engineers, it made reasoning calculable, and logic, switching-circuit design and computing all later stood on it.
